records.text: Anna (Episode 235 livestream commenter; identity unverified) spoke with Erika Kirk

appearances.snippet: Anna writes, “At AmFest 2023, I went alone. At the PBD live podcast, I stood there talking to a woman for the whole hour the show was going on. Talked to her about my heritage, Armenian, and she shared that she and her husband cared deeply about my people. At the end of the conversation, she let me know that she let me know she is Charlie’s wife, Erika.
